promotions.name: Stadtwerke Weimar
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Weimar page explicitly states charging via ladeapp without a charging card at all Stadtwerke Weimar stations and publishes the applicable direct/app prices and blocking rules: AC 0.52 EUR/kWh plus 0.10 EUR/min after 240 minutes capped at 12 EUR; DC 0.60 EUR/kWh plus 0.10 EUR/min after 90 minutes capped at 12 EUR. A dated first-party announcement confirms these ad-hoc prices apply from 2026-03-01 and explicitly defines ad-hoc as spontaneous charging by QR code or ladenetz.de app at Stadtwerke charging points.

promotions.name: Stadtwerke Herrenberg
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Herrenberg charging page explicitly publishes an Ad hoc-Lader tariff and states ad-hoc charging works via smartphone QR reader. Gross tariff: 1.00 EUR start fee, AC 0.67 EUR/kWh, DC 0.60 EUR/kWh. The same page states a blocking fee of 0.10 EUR/min after 240 minutes at SWH charging stations. This directly separates the ad-hoc column from SWH card, ladenetz partner and roaming tariffs.

nextSafeAction: Continue first-party easy queue only where current ad-hoc energy plus fee/scope coverage is explicit; otherwise move directly to chargecloud/Mobilithek-DATEX-II B1/B3/B6 batch, while retaining m8mit Schwerin as location-scoped until estate coverage is proven.
